post.summary:
200 with created = false and duplicateCandidates when an in-scope customer already has one of the
            contact emails/phones; re-send with confirmDuplicate = true to create anyway.
A POST with the rowversion body (like /deactivate), not a DELETE with a body.

CreateCustomerOutcome.description:
Created = false: nothing was written; the candidates are in-scope customers with a matching contact
            email or phone. Re-send with ConfirmDuplicate = true to create anyway.

CustomerDto.description: Contacts: primary first, then by name. Notes: pinned first, then newest first.

RefreshRequest.description: Both fields optional: the browser sends an empty body and the cookie carries the token.
